title: Utility Line Protection Plans: Calculation of the Public-Way Restoration Payment
content:
# Calculation of the Public-Way Restoration Payment

Claims Finance computation note for the Bridgewell Utility Line Protection Plans.

## The calculation

The public-way restoration payment is figured once per service request, on the day it is booked and from the plan's records as they stand that day; periods said to run to the request date end on the service request's request date. The public-way restoration figure is the plan's public way restoration allowance as a flat amount, whatever the restoration crew charges. The public-way restoration payment is never more than the occurrence benefit still open, which is the plan's occurrence cap for the line (the water line occurrence cap for a water service line, the sewer line occurrence cap for a sewer lateral, the gas line occurrence cap for a gas service line) less every amount already authorized, net of reversals, on the service request and on the earlier request whose occurrence it belongs to: for a recall reported no later than the plan's repair guarantee days after the most recent completed repair on the same line, the request of that completed repair, and for a new failure reported no more than the public-way continuation days (14 days) after a temporary repair was authorized on another request for the same line, that temporary-repair request. The public-way restoration payment is rounded to the cent once, at the end.

## The occurrence cap for the line

| Line on the service request | Cap used (a figure of the plan held) |
|---|---|
| exterior water service line | the water line occurrence cap |
| sewer lateral | the sewer line occurrence cap |
| exterior gas service line | the gas line occurrence cap |

## The earlier request joined to the service request

| Service request | Earlier request whose net amounts are also taken from the cap |
|---|---|
| recall, reported no later than the repair guarantee days after the most recent completed repair on the same line | the request of that completed repair |
| new failure, reported no more than 14 days after a temporary repair was authorized on another request for the same line | that temporary-repair request |
| any other request | none |

The repair guarantee days and the public way restoration allowance are figures of the plan held.

## Worked examples (hypothetical figures, not plan values)

Assume a public way restoration allowance of $3000.00 and a water line occurrence cap of $8000.00.

1. Water line request, $2000.00 net already authorized on it, no earlier request joined: open benefit $6000.00; the payment is $3000.00.
2. Water line request, $6200.00 net on it: open benefit $1800.00; the payment is $1800.00.
3. New failure reported 10 days after a temporary repair was authorized on another request for the line, $900.00 net on that request and $6500.00 net on this one: open benefit $600.00; the payment is $600.00.
